eyebrow: Sample from only the k best
code:
def top_k_sample(logits, k=20, temp=1.0):
    logits = logits / temp
    values, idx = torch.topk(logits, k)
    probs = F.softmax(values, dim=-1)
    choice = torch.multinomial(
        probs, num_samples=1)
    return idx.gather(-1, choice)
caption: topk finds the k highest scores; multinomial draws randomly among them.
